definitions.explanation: The front part of the body containing the digestive organs.

examples.japanese: {腹|はら}⟦いっぱい→一杯：01793_ippai⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate until I was full.
It seems I have an upset stomach.

examples.japanese: {腹|はら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|わ}って→割る：02334_waru⟧⟦{話|はな}しましょう→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。

examples.english: I can't figure out what he's thinking.

examples.japanese: {腹|はら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
⟦{腹黒|はらぐろ}い→腹黒い：07740_haraguroi⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。

notes:
{腹|はら} literally means belly or abdomen, but is used extensively in figurative expressions relating to emotions, intentions, and resolve. In Japanese culture, the belly is traditionally seen as the seat of one's true feelings.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS (literal):
- {腹|はら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧: to be hungry
- {腹|はら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: to have a stomachache
- {腹|はら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}す→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧: to have an upset stomach

COMMON EXPRESSIONS (figurative):
- {腹|はら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to get angry
- {腹|はら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|わ}って→割る：02334_waru⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to speak frankly ("split open the belly")
- {腹|はら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to make up one's mind
- {腹|はら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}めない→読む：00426_yomu⟧: can't figure out what someone is thinking

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{空腹|くうふく}→空腹：06532_kuufuku⟧: hunger (empty belly)
- ⟦{満腹|まんぷく}→満腹：06533_manpuku⟧: full stomach
- ⟦{腹黒|はらぐろ}い→腹黒い：07740_haraguroi⟧: scheming, malicious ("black-bellied")

Note: More colloquial than ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧ (stomach as an organ) or ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧ (politer word for belly).
